tools.name: courier_list_messages
tools.description: List recently sent messages, newest first, with status, recipient, channel and provider. Filter by status, event, list, recipient, tag or enqueued_after. Paged by cursor. GET /messages.

tools.name: courier_get_message
tools.description: Get one message by id (the requestId returned by courier_send_message), with its delivery status and provider. GET /messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: courier_get_message_history
tools.description: Get the delivery history events for one message (status changes per channel). GET /messages/{message_id}/history.

tools.name: courier_list_notification_templates
tools.description: List the workspace notification templates with their name, tags, brand, routing and draft or published state. GET /notifications.

tools.name: courier_get_notification_template
tools.description: Get one notification template by id or alias. Returns the published version by default; version=draft returns the unpublished one. GET /notifications/{id}.

tools.name: courier_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (logo, colors, layout) that templates can use. GET /brands.

tools.name: courier_get_brand
tools.description: Get one brand by id, with its colors, logo and layout settings. GET /brands/{brand_id}.

tools.name: courier_list_lists
tools.description: List the static recipient lists in the workspace. Optionally filter by list id pattern. GET /lists.

tools.name: courier_get_list
tools.description: Get one list by id, with its name and metadata. GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: courier_list_list_subscribers
tools.description: List the user subscriptions of one list, with their preferences. Paged by cursor. GET /lists/{list_id}/subscriptions.

tools.name: courier_get_profile
tools.description: Get one user profile: the contact details Courier delivers to (email, phone, push tokens) and custom data. GET /profiles/{user_id}.

tools.name: courier_get_user_preferences
tools.description: Get one user's notification preferences per topic and per channel. GET /users/{user_id}/preferences.

tools.name: courier_list_providers
tools.description: List the channel providers configured in the workspace (email, SMS, push, chat). GET /providers.

tools.name: courier_list_journeys
tools.description: List the multi-step journeys (workflows) in the workspace. GET /journeys.

tools.name: courier_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List one-off broadcasts (sends to a list or audience), with their state. GET /broadcasts.

tools.name: courier_list_automations
tools.description: List the automation templates that you can invoke with courier_invoke_automation. GET /automations.

tools.name: courier_list_tenants
tools.description: List tenants (organizations, teams or accounts that users belong to). GET /tenants.

tools.name: courier_list_audit_events
tools.description: List workspace audit events (who changed what in the console or through the API). Paged by cursor. GET /audit-events.

tools.name: courier_send_message
tools.description: Send a notification from a template to one recipient, a list or a tenant. Courier routes it to the channels in the template. Sends real messages. Pass an idempotency_key to make retries safe. Returns a requestId. POST /send.

tools.name: courier_cancel_message
tools.description: Cancel a message that is queued or scheduled and not yet delivered. POST /messages/{message_id}/cancel.

tools.name: courier_subscribe_user_to_list
tools.description: Subscribe one user to a list, with optional per-topic preferences. Idempotent: subscribing again updates the subscription. PUT /lists/{list_id}/subscriptions/{user_id}.

tools.name: courier_unsubscribe_user_from_list
tools.description: Remove one user's subscription from a list, so the list no longer sends to that user. DELETE /lists/{list_id}/subscriptions/{user_id}.

tools.name: courier_invoke_automation
tools.description: Run an automation template for one recipient, with data. The automation sends its messages. POST /automations/{templateId}/invoke.

tools.name: courier_track_event
tools.description: Send a track event for one user, tied to a message id, so journeys and automations can react to it. Records a real event in the workspace. POST /inbound/courier.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: courier_list_messages, courier_get_message, courier_get_message_history, courier_list_notification_templates, courier_get_notification_template, courier_get_profile, courier_get_user_preferences, courier_list_providers, courier_send_message · Private data: courier_get_profile, courier_track_event · Public sink: courier_get_profile, courier_list_providers, courier_send_message, courier_cancel_message, courier_invoke_automation, courier_track_event · Destructive: courier_unsubscribe_user_from_list, courier_invoke_automation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: courier_list_messages, courier_get_message, courier_get_message_history, courier_list_notification_templates, courier_get_notification_template, courier_get_profile, courier_get_user_preferences, courier_list_providers, courier_send_message · Private data: courier_get_profile, courier_track_event · Public sink: courier_get_profile, courier_list_providers, courier_send_message, courier_cancel_message, courier_invoke_automation, courier_track_event · Destructive: courier_unsubscribe_user_from_list, courier_invoke_automation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
